pages.text: Right-click a player with a blank card to bind it. Right-click to open.

Title page: name and callsign, birth date, sex, blood type, unit, allergies, chronic conditions, implants, special notes. The pencil in the corner — edit mode.$(br2)History: date, injury or diagnosis, circumstances, consequences.

Entries are proposed when a doctor $(l)carrying a medical record$() examines the patient and finds a problem (device or examination): accept ✓, decline ✗ or edit.$(br2)A blood test report — the "Attach test" button, if it is in your inventory.
